tools.name: dpdp_key_dates
tools.description: Key dates under the India DPDP Rules, 2025: when the Rules were notified and when each group of obligations begins (Consent Managers, Data Fiduciary duties, penalties). Includes the confidence and review status of each.

tools.name: dpdp_obligations
tools.description: Look up DPDP Act sections and Rules by topic (for example: breach, consent, grievance, children, processor contract, erasure, security safeguards, transfers). Returns matching summaries with confidence and review status.

tools.name: dpdp_penalty_ceilings
tools.description: The maximum penalties in the Schedule to the DPDP Act and the factors the Data Protection Board considers. These are ceilings, not an estimate of what any business would pay.

tools.name: openproof_pricing
tools.description: OpenProof's current public plans: the three annual tiers with price in INR before taxes, what each includes and its limits, and the free trial length. Read live from the same source as the pricing page.

tools.name: scan_site
tools.description: Run OpenProof's website scan on one public web address and return the DPDP-related signals found: consent banner and cookies before consent, third-party trackers, privacy-policy presence and content signals, signup-form consent checkbox, sensitive-field collection and TLS.
